reason: A DSH Web file-explorer preview plugin that renders supported protein and small-molecule structure files as interactive Mol* 3D visualizations, with read-only controls and no editing capability.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 文件浏览器中将支持的蛋白质和小分子结构文件以可交互的 Mol* 三维模型进行只读预览。
summaries.en: Provides read-only interactive Mol* 3D previews for supported protein and small-molecule structure files in the DSH Web file explorer.

capabilities: Reads selected molecular structure files through the file explorer service
Renders interactive 3D molecular structures in the browser
Adds preview controls for representation, coloring, camera, spinning, and background theme
